tool_input.command:
git -C <repo> commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs(doctor): reattach two run-together doc comments to their functions

A comment block that documents function A, followed by a second
declaration inserted between it and A, becomes one contiguous block that
Go attaches to the intruder: the intruder's doc opens by describing a
different function, and A is left with none. Two instances in the
tracked tree, both fixed by splitting the block; no text changed, only
placement.

- internal/doctor/sandbox.go — shQuote's comment ended up above
  removeSandbox. This branch did it to itself: bf1deca added shQuote and
  its comment adjacently, 7450dd2 then inserted removeSandbox between
  them. Reported by Copilot on PR #515; its "also appears on line 446"
  is the same defect seen from the orphaned-function end, not a second
  instance.
- cmd/ethos/session.go — printSessionStart's comment ended up above
  var safeSessionID, same shape. Outside this branch's diff; found by
  sweeping the class rather than the instance.

Swept with a throwaway go/ast scanner (flag any declaration whose doc
opens by naming a different declaration in the same file) over cmd/,
internal/, and plugin/: 2 hits before, 0 after. The other hits it
reported were stale copies under .worktrees/ and .tmp/, not tracked
files. Scanner deleted — it is a one-shot sweep, not a gate worth
carrying.
EOF
)" -- cmd/ethos/session.go internal/doctor/sandbox.go
